context_requirements: Expression of calcineurin (PPP3CA/PPP3R) and NFAT transcription factors
An active calcineurin-NFAT signaling pathway, typically driven by TCR or calcium-mobilizing receptor signaling
Presence of immunophilins (FKBP1A, PPIA, PPIF) for drug binding
Cell types with low basal NFAT activity may show minimal transcriptional response
falsifiers: No change in NFATC3, NFATC4, or RCAN1 at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line
Strong upregulation of NFAT target genes (e.g., IL2, RCAN1) rather than downregulation
No difference in proliferation or cell-cycle gene expression at 24 h compared to vehicle
Consistent strong transcriptional responses in all nine lines, including those lacking calcineurin/NFAT expression
